annotations.jsonrpc: Protocol version marker for every MCP JSON-RPC message.
annotations.id: Correlates each request with its response; notifications have no id.
annotations.method: The MCP operation: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, or tools/call.
annotations.params: Arguments for the operation; tools/call contains the discovered tool name and arguments.
annotations.serverInfo: Identity of the MCP server, not the model host.
annotations.capabilities: Features the server advertises during handshake.
annotations.tools: The complete tool definitions and input schemas returned by tools/list.
annotations.content: The tool result content returned to the host.
annotations.structuredContent: The structured tool result returned by the server.
annotations.isError: Whether the tool call failed; false means the call succeeded.
annotations.model_location: The model runs in the host application; neither MCP server makes a model call.

tools.name: lookup_contract
tools.description: Look up one contract by its repository identifier and return its effective date and amendments.

tools.name: get_effective_date
tools.description: Return the executed effective date for one contract identifier.

tools.name: get_amendment_chain
tools.description: Return the executed amendment chain for one contract identifier.
